Applying its theorem to the quotient of any onto endpoint T is a direct consequence of the pre-existing fiber-identification: norm-sum indistinguishability makes the induced quotient map well-defined, and surjectivity makes it onto. value.rationale: The endpoint problem is naturally motivated, and displaying the complete combined classification is pedagogically useful. But as a stand-alone new mathematical result the entire quotient/fiber decomposition is an already published exact theorem, and the quotient action follows mechanically by applying an already published Banach–Stone theorem after descending an onto map through the identified kernel. The additional steps are standard passage to a quotient and reassembling fibers, with no new difficult structural lemma, independent parameter range, classification beyond the known ingredients or unknown invariant. As an explanatory synthesis it is useful, but not a distinct scientific finding meeting the value criterion; this is not a penalty for short proofs but for complete immediate implication.
